text:
ying: FYI hitting flaky ordering + dup fragments when using EventSource in sample-app after OAuth token refresh. toggling network or letting the token expire reproduces ~30% runs.
ying: short dump:
```
[2027-03-10T15:04:12.100Z] conn open id=session-900
[2027-03-10T15:04:12.300Z] sse id=101 data=chunkA
[2027-03-10T15:04:12.450Z] auth refresh triggered, client reconnected
[2027-03-10T15:04:12.600Z] sse id=103 data=chunkC
[2027-03-10T15:04:12.720Z] sse id=102 data=chunkB
[2027-03-10T15:04:12.830Z] sse id=103 data=chunkC (dup)
```
ying: sample-app uses eventsource-polyfill + browser-sdk v1.0.0-alpha. EventSource doesn't let me set Last-Event-ID header on reconnect so server-side resume is best-effort and we see duplicates.
noah: ouch. does runtime emit `id:` for each logical fragment? any proxy in the chain?
ying: yes id per-fragment. local flow is dev-proxy -> staging. tcp capture shows server wrote tail frames to both sockets around reconnect.
sam: two quick notes: 1) EventSource relies on automatic reconnection and sends Last-Event-ID only if the server set the `id:` lines and the client supports it — polyfills vary. 2) fetch+reader allows explicit header control.
ying: i switched the sample to fetch+reader and manually set Last-Event-ID on reconnect and duplicates dropped a lot, but ordering still flips on some runs.
kelsey: client-side ops: buffer fragments keyed by id, apply in-order with a small timeout (e.g., 300ms), and dedupe by (id, hash). SDK should offer this as opt-in. server-side: runtime should avoid emitting same chunk to old sockets once a resume is accepted.
noah: we also should add jittered auth refresh backoff so two credential refreshes don't spawn parallel reconnects.
ying: quick patch plan: 1) sample-app: add EventSource fallback detection and prefer fetch on auth flows, 2) SDK: expose `stream.resumeStrategy = "auto" | "strict"` (auto = best-effort, strict = last-id enforced + de-dupe+reorder buffer), 3) runtime ticket for emission guard.
ci-bot: CI: sample-app/feat/eventsource-resume #34 passed (unit: 68) :white_check_mark: 
ying: i'll open PR and infra ticket, attaching tcp capture + polyfill config. tagging @kelsey @sam for infra/sdk follow-up.
noah: +1. also log a small metric when SDK sees out-of-order ids so infra can correlate with tcp captures.
kelsey: agreed. i'll file INFRA-2001 for the emission guard and proxy drain checks. thanks for the repro and capture! :thumbsup:
